releases.title: File I/O, modules, GNU toolchain and formatting
releases.summary: Add detailed C format and I/O contracts, module headers, header guards, compiler and linking flags, static/shared libraries and stream-versus-descriptor guidance; no changes to Bash.

releases.title: C structures, arguments, arrays, and operators
releases.summary: Expanded pointer modifications, nested struct access and equality, enum, function arguments, array pointer expressions, casts, logical and bitwise operators, and address-mask precedence and portability.

releases.title: Pointer declarations and address operators
releases.summary: Compare * and & in declarations, initialization, expressions, and scanf, with a dedicated guide and focused examples.

releases.title: Standard streams and reliable file input
releases.summary: Expanded C99 reference for stdin/stdout/stderr, argc/argv, file modes and return values, input source selection, and line-by-line integer validation with preserved diagnostics.

releases.title: Comprehensive C99 foundations and standard library
releases.summary: Introduced an extensive, searchable C99 reference covering syntax, types, functions, pointers, arrays, strings, memory, files, standard library utilities, builds and debugging; includes C11 notes and detailed guides.

releases.title: C / C++ library scaffold
releases.summary: Created an empty, independent C / C++ reference with its own version history.
